areaGuide.title: Living in Bukit Jalil – Complete Guide to Room Rental, Condo & Apartment Rental in Kuala Lumpur
areaGuide.description: Bukit Jalil is one of Kuala Lumpur's fastest-growing and most desirable residential townships for room rental, condominium rental, serviced apartment rental and apartment rental. Well known for its modern developments, excellent infrastructure, world-class sports facilities, universities, shopping malls and outstanding public transportation, Bukit Jalil has become a preferred destination for students, working professionals, expatriates, digital nomads, couples and families. Whether you are searching for a master room for rent in Bukit Jalil, a fully furnished single room, medium room, condo room, studio apartment, serviced residence, luxury condominium or affordable apartment rental, Bukit Jalil offers accommodation choices suitable for every budget and lifestyle. Residents enjoy excellent connectivity through Bukit Jalil LRT Station, Muhibbah LRT Station, Awan Besar LRT Station, Sri Petaling LRT Station, the MEX Highway, KESAS Highway, Bukit Jalil Highway and major roads connecting Kuala Lumpur City Centre, TRX, Bukit Bintang, Mid Valley City, Bangsar South, Petaling Jaya, Puchong and Subang Jaya. The township is home to iconic landmarks including Pavilion Bukit Jalil, National Stadium Bukit Jalil, Axiata Arena, Bukit Jalil Recreational Park, Technology Park Malaysia and International Medical University (IMU), making Bukit Jalil one of Kuala Lumpur's strongest rental property markets with consistently high demand from students, professionals and families.

faqs.question: How much does a room for rent in Bukit Jalil cost?
faqs.answer: Room rental prices in Bukit Jalil generally range from RM700 to RM2,600 per month depending on the room type, furnishing, condominium facilities, property age and proximity to LRT or MRT stations.

faqs.question: Where can I find affordable rooms for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Affordable room rentals can be found throughout Bukit Jalil, especially in established condominiums, apartments and shared residences near Bukit Jalil LRT Station, Muhibbah LRT Station and Awan Besar LRT Station.

faqs.question: Are fully furnished rooms available for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many rental rooms in Bukit Jalil come fully furnished with beds, wardrobes, air conditioning, WiFi, washing machines, kitchen access and condominium facilities.

faqs.question: What types of rooms are available for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Bukit Jalil offers single rooms, medium rooms, master rooms, private rooms, shared rooms, studio apartments, serviced apartments and condominium units suitable for students, professionals and families.

faqs.question: How much is a master room for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Master room rentals typically range from RM1,400 to RM2,600 per month depending on the condominium, attached bathroom, furnishing and available facilities.

faqs.question: How much is a single room for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Single rooms generally cost between RM700 and RM1,300 per month depending on the location, property type and included amenities.

faqs.question: How much is a medium room for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Medium rooms usually range from RM950 to RM1,700 per month depending on the property, facilities and room size.

faqs.question: Are studio apartments available for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bukit Jalil offers modern studio apartments and serviced residences with private kitchens, bathrooms and condominium facilities suitable for professionals and couples.

faqs.question: Is Bukit Jalil a good place to rent a room in Kuala Lumpur?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bukit Jalil is a popular residential township with excellent public transport, shopping malls, parks, universities, sports facilities and convenient access to major employment centres.

faqs.question: Is Bukit Jalil suitable for working professionals?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many professionals choose Bukit Jalil because of its convenient access to Technology Park Malaysia, Bangsar South, Mid Valley City, TRX and Kuala Lumpur city centre.

faqs.question: Are there rooms near Bukit Jalil LRT Station?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many condominiums and serviced apartments are located within a short distance of Bukit Jalil LRT Station, making commuting convenient for tenants.

faqs.question: Are there rooms near TPM MRT Station?
faqs.answer: Yes. Properties near TPM MRT Station are popular among professionals and students because of convenient MRT access and proximity to Technology Park Malaysia.

faqs.question: Can I find rental rooms near Pavilion Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. Numerous condominiums and serviced residences are located around Pavilion Bukit Jalil, offering convenient access to shopping, dining and entertainment.

faqs.question: Is Bukit Jalil popular among students?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bukit Jalil is a preferred location for students due to its proximity to International Medical University (IMU), Asia Pacific University (APU) and other nearby educational institutions.

faqs.question: Can foreigners rent rooms in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many landlords and property managers rent to international tenants, subject to standard tenancy requirements and documentation.

faqs.question: Are there luxury condominiums for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bukit Jalil offers many modern condominiums and serviced residences featuring swimming pools, gyms, landscaped gardens, co-working spaces, security and covered parking.

faqs.question: Which are the popular condominiums in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Popular developments include The Park Sky Residence, Aurora Place, The Park 2, CloudTree Residence, Twin Arkz, Kiara Residence, Savanna Executive Suites and The Link 2.

faqs.question: Is Bukit Jalil more affordable than Kuala Lumpur City Centre?
faqs.answer: Generally yes. Bukit Jalil often offers more spacious accommodation and modern facilities at lower rental prices than Kuala Lumpur City Centre while maintaining good transport connections.

faqs.question: Are there affordable apartments for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bukit Jalil offers apartments and condominium units across different budgets, making it suitable for students, young professionals and families.

faqs.question: Are student rooms available in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. Many landlords offer student-friendly rooms with furnished living spaces and convenient access to universities and public transport.

faqs.question: Are female-only rooms available in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. Some landlords provide female-only accommodation depending on the property and tenancy preferences.

faqs.question: Are couple-friendly rooms available in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Many master rooms, studio apartments and entire units may be suitable for couples, subject to the landlord's tenancy terms.

faqs.question: Are rooms with private bathrooms available in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. Master bedrooms and selected premium rooms commonly include attached private bathrooms.

faqs.question: Are utilities included in Bukit Jalil room rentals?
faqs.answer: Some rentals include utilities such as internet, water and electricity, while others charge separately. The terms vary by listing.

faqs.question: Do Bukit Jalil rental rooms include WiFi?
faqs.answer: Many furnished rooms include WiFi, especially in shared apartments and modern serviced residences.

faqs.question: Can I find short-term rental rooms in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Some landlords offer flexible or short-term rental arrangements, depending on availability and building management policies.

faqs.question: What documents are usually required to rent a room in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Most landlords require identification, a signed tenancy agreement and rental deposits before move-in.

faqs.question: How much deposit is usually required for a room rental in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Many landlords request a security deposit together with a utility deposit, although the exact amount depends on the tenancy agreement.

faqs.question: Can I live in Bukit Jalil without owning a car?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bukit Jalil has LRT access, MRT connections nearby, bus services, ride-hailing options and many everyday amenities within easy reach.

faqs.question: What facilities do Bukit Jalil condominiums usually provide?
faqs.answer: Common facilities include swimming pools, fitness centres, security, playgrounds, BBQ areas, multipurpose halls, gardens and covered parking.

faqs.question: Is parking available with Bukit Jalil room rentals?
faqs.answer: Many condominiums offer parking spaces, although availability depends on the specific property and rental agreement.

faqs.question: Is Bukit Jalil suitable for remote workers?
faqs.answer: Yes. The area offers reliable internet, modern residential developments, cafés, co-working spaces and convenient lifestyle amenities.

faqs.question: Why do many people choose to live in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Residents are attracted by modern housing, convenient transport, parks, shopping centres, universities, sports facilities and good connectivity to major business districts.

faqs.question: What are some popular residential areas within Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Popular residential developments include The Park Sky Residence, Aurora Place, The Park 2, Twin Arkz, CloudTree Residence, Kiara Residence and Savanna Executive Suites.

faqs.question: Is Bukit Jalil considered a safe place to live?
faqs.answer: Many residential developments in Bukit Jalil are gated or provide 24-hour security, access control and CCTV, contributing to a secure living environment.

faqs.question: Are serviced apartments available for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Yes. The area has a variety of serviced apartments offering furnished units and lifestyle facilities suitable for professionals, students and long-term residents.

faqs.question: How can I choose the right room for rent in Bukit Jalil?
faqs.answer: Compare rental prices, room size, furnishing, transport access, facilities, tenancy terms and nearby amenities to find a property that best matches your needs and budget.
